title: Group Anagrams
hints: Anagrams become identical when you sort their letters.
Group the words by their sorted-letter key — `Dictionary(grouping:by:)` does this in one call.
jsBridge: lodash `groupBy` corresponds to `Dictionary(grouping: words, by: { String($0.sorted()) })`. The key is a sorted `String`. In JS you'd sort `w.split('')`, and Swift sorts `Character`s directly.

compass.q: Sorted-string key vs a 26-count letter signature: which is O(k) instead of O(k log k)? Can the count signature be a dictionary key in Swift?
In JS you'd need `JSON.stringify` to use an array as a Map key. Why can Swift use `[Int]` directly as a dictionary key?
Where does "group by" appear in iOS UIs: sectioned lists by date or first letter? Which SwiftUI API renders sections?
